verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a public registry service, which could ship a conversational assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows a REST API, keyword search forms and online filing services. Those are developer building blocks or conventional interfaces, not natural-language command handling, and no assistant or agent-oriented interface (not even llms.txt) is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
